_README: Name the seven tarsal pieces the male bundle carries as `tarsals_r/l` (the DU release ships each bone separately;
piece order = the position among the pieces of that id in the bundle's structure list
source: Andreassen et al. 2023, Sci Data 10:34, doi:10.1038/s41597-022-01905-2 (CC BY 4.0), Visible Human male lower-limb release; named by the geometric rule in scripts/transfer/name_tarsal_pieces.py
